Purana Portal

The Purana (पुराण, purāṇas) refers to Sanskrit literature preserving ancient India’s vast cultural history, including historical legends, religious ceremonies, various arts and sciences. The eighteen 
mahapuranas
 total over 400,000 
shlokas
 (metrical couplets) and date to at least several centuries BCE.
